title: IPC admin.peers.add_address and admin.peers.remove_address params
description: One bootstrap address (ADR-0062): a multiaddr-with-peer-id in the configuration's grammar, direct (/<ip4|ip6|dns4|dns6>/<host>/tcp/<port>/p2p/<peer>) or a circuit route through a relay (<relay route>/p2p/<relay>/p2p-circuit/p2p/<peer>). The method parses it by that grammar and nothing looser; a string that fails it is answered as a refusal by name, never an error. The length bound refuses an absurd string before it is parsed; it is not the grammar.
